## Design

### 2026-10-25 – 23/10:  Starting the MIDI Keyboard!!

**2.5h**

23/10:  Starting the MIDI Keyboard!!

I originally had another idea for this weeks instrument theme but also realised I didn't really fully understand how everything works yet so I decided to end up following the guide :)
![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 11.25.48 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/086e2e6f1aa9edba47921146301a7b3b81e87da07930d328f7e135b4075c6533.png)
Opening up KiCad and starting to place the symbols! Had to do a bit of troubleshooting because when I was downloading the footprints and symbols, the default KiCad library had some error(?) so the symbols weren't showing up. Kinda panicked but googled it and managed to fix it (temporarily... it came back again later!)  So starting off took quite a while more than I expected.

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 4.31.46 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/9ca620a8234278ae2b8e3c6936b9f442871781e014832067372777e051c0b3b6.png)
Finished with the schematic! There are a lot more components this time round compared to Starbie :o

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 4.33.00 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/e83bc25c1f7d3f7f08ab3be959f78971e7f9e3f952a79429dd1a30ce6c693dbf.png)
Tried to assign footprints to move on to the PCB editor but guess what! Uh yup so same error.. :D
I was flabbergasted when I went to assign the footprints and saw... nothing!
Googled, googled and googled some more and yay got it to work! I was considering resetting my libraries like I had at the start (because I only had 2 then) but I did not want to have to import everything again so I clicked here and there and somehow got it to work..?

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 4.44.30 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/0bbc800f1c979fd82b54f6531ac1d2820ac6ea2da5878c032d8f8b6a887069f4.png)
Anyway! Finally assigned the footprints to the components and ended the day there!

### 2026-10-25 – 24/10: Designing the PCB layout!

**5h**

24/10: Designing the PCB layout!

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 4.55.07 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/7b815f74bd580e6a4d1417711db7280454bc28d055d6d8476162858256e9ac05.png)
Once all of the footprints were assigned correctly, everything was updated into the PCB editor :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 5.10.30 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/cfb5088860be07024039e03425ce9f09a860559594985bb9fe8ff926607a44a8.png)
Got started on making the footprint for the capacitive keys, but didn't know how to make them not overlap... I tried making the pad 'custom' but it was still restricted to either a circular or rectangular base. Tried searching up how to make it but to no avail... So I decided to just make it a different layout! An unconventional keyboard haha!

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 at 5.31.58 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/1bbeecf07432d30868b21a9a547a50f2f1b88edcf43b0153afa0bf3944cf9e6f.png)
Ended up with this :D It may not be the most ergonomic right now but hey it works! After this, I saved the footprint to my library and added it to the PCB editor. And then I realised hey it's a little too small! So I went back to the footprint editor, made it a little bigger, with bigger spacings and then saved and added it again. This went for a few too many more times until I was satisfied. Until I wasn't :P

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 6.00.48 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/cf542f9ecba37237a1d6762ea41e3b0e1aa5aaba067e86129ae2f0c86a716e32.png)
I took a look at my PCB and well it looked wayyyy too similar to the guide so I wanted to change it up at least a little bit yk! So I made the capacitive keys oval shaped instead :D And yay I like it! However, I did still want it to be a bit bigger to fit the width of everything that was going to be above the keys, so I played around with the sizes and spacings a bit more until I was satisfied. Finally, I could properly lay out the PCB :>

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 5.40.34 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/a740e91e3a1306ff8bec3c442f57fe2a3ca8d985b59c08eb6c1e66b61e5810ec.png)
Learning point: Made my own footprint library!!
